name: EPIC 202647171
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 8.5 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 202647171 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.508942 (16th-84th percentiles 8.274554-8.798084), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,232 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.88 solar masses and 8.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,772 K at its surface.
